title: centaurea jacea subsp. ruscinonensis
intro: Centaurea jacea subsp. ruscinonensis, commonly known as a type of knapweed, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and digestive problems. The health benefits of Centaurea jacea subsp. ruscinonensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
